mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_inventory (id, material_id, location_id, batch_no, quantity, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{materialId}, #{locationId}, #{batchNo}, #{quantity}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{updateBy}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW()
